environment.graphics: ANGLE NVIDIA RTX 3080 Direct3D11 (metadata only; Canvas2D timings are CPU submission time)
environment.hostDisplayQuery: 2560×1440, CurrentRefreshRate=239; Meta Virtual Monitor also present
environment.audio: Game music and FX enabled; browser output --mute-audio

notes: Local full production App, HUD, music, FX, Canvas2D rendering; disposable same-seed course/card fixture plus real CDP touch/Lift/menu inputs. No physics, terrain, visual density, effects or music disabled.
Normal RAF callback cadence on this host is about 160–175/s, not a physical-display scanout measurement. Uncapped rows measure throughput only.

Contiguous per-phase render intervals exclude actual phase transitions and explicit pause/retry waits. No interval threshold censoring is applied. Phase wall-time estimates use ~90ms polling and can include control/entry waits.
Older terminal-clear measurement did not label each render completing separately; its active bucket includes the completion reveal. Use terminal screen and raw states for transition proof.
45s session retained the same browser page/process across one natural death and a normal UI retry. The engine and canvas view were recreated normally; it is two flights, not one 45s flight.

63ms and 66ms long tasks appeared during the retry transition. One separate profiled repeat reproduced 67ms/69ms tasks dominated by synchronous route-preview geometry and real flight construction; original tasks were unprofiled. Fresh first-entry construction also has >50ms tasks. Steady active intervals in the 45s session had no >50ms gaps.
CPU render duration is not GPU completion time; no GPU timings or phone FPS claimed.
Snapshot hashes describe the measured source before the later release cache-version stamp. Art modules/assets were not edited. Raw JSON/CPU profiles/screenshots stay in ignored work/perf120.
